note: Regenerated at runtime by the collector across every game it touches. It exists so the classifier can never claim to detect an event type that has not actually been observed.
consequence: No video-review event type was observed, so no automated 'video review' filter is offered. Review-driven goal changes are still detectable as goal_removed / no_goal_to_goal state changes; the *reason* stays unknown unless an official artifact states it in words.
